title: Clickety-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Drifting among sunken arches of frosted sea-glass and swaying amber kelp, this inquisitive cephalopod ripples with kaleidoscopic bursts of bioluminescent light whenever a curious face peers through the glass. It spends its days clicking softly like a tiny typewriter as it meticulously rearranges smooth pebbles and shiny shells across the sand into intricate, ever-shifting constellations.
